The state Finance Department has issued Government Orders (GOs) Nos. 141 and 142 for the recruitment […]HYDERABAD: The Telangana government has issued orders to fill vacant assistant professor posts in state universities. In the first phase, 429 assistant professor posts across seven universities will be filled through direct recruitment, including 49 posts at Satavahana University. The state Finance Department has issued Government Orders (GOs) Nos. 141 and 142 for the recruitment process. Notifications are expected by the end of October, in accordance with common guidelines and the roster system. Engineering college to recruit faculty across disciplines At the University College of Engineering, Husnabad, vacancies will be filled in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Artificial Intelligence, Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Information Technology (IT), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) and Mechanical Engineering. The recruitment will also cover English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Physical Education and librarian posts. Law, pharmacy and commerce departments included Assistant professor posts will also be filled at the University College of Law, University College of Pharmaceutical Sciences, and University College of Commerce and Business Management. Recruitment expected to strengthen higher education The appointments are expected to strengthen higher education and help provide quality teaching to students. Eligible unemployed youth have been urged to make use of the opportunity. ]]>
